senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) [hostile meeting, cmp. זָוַג, מִלְחָמָה &c.,] going to war; כלי נ׳ (or sub. כלי) weapon, armor.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 15:2:2">Y. Yeb. XV, 14ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 140:8">Ps. CXL, 8</cite>) <he>נִשְׁקוֹ של גוג</he> the day of war against Gog (v. <cite ref="G00311"><he>זִיּוּן</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888:9">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite>.
